title: Conduct anatomical examinations only at licensed premises
what: Keep bodies for anatomical examination, and conduct anatomical examinations, only at licensed premises.

sources.title: Anatomy Act 1977 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person shall not keep a body in the person's possession for anatomical examination at any place other than licensed premises

sources.title: Anatomy Act 1977 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct an anatomical examination of a body at any place other than licensed premises

administration.who: Director-General of the Department of Health (NSW)
